arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Qad aflahal mu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
translations.en.pickthall: Successful indeed are the believers
translations.en.yusufali: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang-orang yang beriman,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena hum fee Salaatihim khaashi'oon

translations.en.sahih: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
translations.en.pickthall: Who are humble in their prayers,
translations.en.yusufali: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang khusyu' dalam sembahyangnya,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon

translations.en.sahih: And they who turn away from ill speech
translations.en.pickthall: And who shun vain conversation,
translations.en.yusufali: Who avoid vain talk;
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang menjauhkan diri dari (perbuatan dan perkataan) yang tiada berguna,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum liz Zakaati faa'iloon

translations.en.sahih: And they who are observant of zakah
translations.en.pickthall: And who are payers of the poor-due;
translations.en.yusufali: Who are active in deeds of charity;
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang menunaikan zakat,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon

translations.en.sahih: And they who guard their private parts
translations.en.pickthall: And who guard their modesty -
translations.en.yusufali: Who abstain from sex,
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang menjaga kemaluannya,

arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
transliteration: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen

translations.en.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
translations.en.pickthall: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
translations.en.yusufali: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali terhadap isteri-isteri mereka atau budak yang mereka miliki; maka sesungguhnya mereka dalam hal ini tiada tercela.

arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
transliteration: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

translations.en.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
translations.en.pickthall: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
translations.en.yusufali: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa mencari yang di balik itu maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

translations.en.sahih: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
translations.en.pickthall: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
translations.en.yusufali: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara amanat-amanat (yang dipikulnya) dan janjinya.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum 'alaa Salawaatihim yuhaafizoon

translations.en.sahih: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
translations.en.pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.
translations.en.yusufali: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang memelihara sembahyangnya.

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
transliteration: Ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon

translations.en.sahih: Those are the inheritors
translations.en.pickthall: These are the heirs
translations.en.yusufali: These will be the heirs,
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itulah orang-orang yang akan mewarisi,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena yarisoonal Firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
translations.en.pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
translations.en.yusufali: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
translations.id.indonesian: (yakni) yang akan mewarisi surga Firdaus. Mereka kekal di dalamnya.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen

translations.en.sahih: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
translations.en.pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
translations.en.yusufali: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari suatu saripati (berasal) dari tanah.

arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
transliteration: Summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen

translations.en.sahih: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
translations.en.pickthall: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
translations.en.yusufali: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami jadikan saripati itu air mani (yang disimpan) dalam tempat yang kokoh (rahim).

arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
transliteration: Summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

translations.en.sahih: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
translations.en.pickthall: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
translations.en.yusufali: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian air mani itu Kami jadikan segumpal darah, lalu segumpal darah itu Kami jadikan segumpal daging, dan segumpal daging itu Kami jadikan tulang belulang, lalu tulang belulang itu Kami bungkus dengan daging. Kemudian Kami jadikan dia makhluk yang (berbentuk) lain. Maka Maha sucilah Allah, Pencipta Yang Paling Baik.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
transliteration: Summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
translations.en.yusufali: After that, at length ye will die
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, sesudah itu, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian benar-benar akan mati.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
transliteration: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati tub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
translations.en.yusufali: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian akan dibangkitkan (dari kuburmu) di hari kiamat.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen

translations.en.sahih: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
translations.en.pickthall: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
translations.en.yusufali: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan di atas kamu tujuh buah jalan (tujuh buah langit); dan Kami tidaklah lengah terhadap ciptaan (Kami).

arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon

translations.en.sahih: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
translations.en.pickthall: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
translations.en.yusufali: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami turunkan air dari langit menurut suatu ukuran; lalu Kami jadikan air itu menetap di bumi, dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar berkuasa menghilangkannya.

arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Fa anshaanaa lakum bihee Jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

translations.en.sahih: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
translations.en.yusufali: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dengan air itu, Kami tumbuhkan untuk kamu kebun-kebun kurma dan anggur; di dalam kebun-kebun itu kamu peroleh buah-buahan yang banyak dan sebahagian dari buah-buahan itu kamu makan,

arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
transliteration: Wa shajaratan takhruju min Toori Sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen

translations.en.sahih: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
translations.en.pickthall: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
translations.en.yusufali: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
translations.id.indonesian: dan pohon kayu keluar dari Thursina (pohon zaitun), yang menghasilkan minyak, dan pemakan makanan bagi orang-orang yang makan.

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
translations.en.yusufali: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya pada binatang-binatang ternak, benar-benar terdapat pelajaran yang penting bagi kamu, Kami memberi minum kamu dari air susu yang ada dalam perutnya, dan (juga) pada binatang-binatang ternak itu terdapat faedah yang banyak untuk kamu, dan sebagian daripadanya kamu makan,

arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon

translations.en.sahih: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
translations.en.pickthall: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
translations.en.yusufali: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
translations.id.indonesian: dan di atas punggung binatang-binatang ternak itu dan (juga) di atas perahu-perahu kamu diangkut.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus Nuh kepada kaumnya, lalu ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, sembahlah oleh kamu Allah, (karena) sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan bagimu selain Dia. Maka mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa (kepada-Nya)?"

arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
translations.en.pickthall: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
translations.en.yusufali: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pemuka-pemuka orang yang kafir di antara kaumnya menjawab: "Orang ini tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kamu, yang bermaksud hendak menjadi seorang yang lebih tinggi dari kamu. Dan kalau Allah menghendaki, tentu Dia mengutus beberapa orang malaikat. Belum pernah kami mendengar (seruan yang seperti) ini pada masa nenek moyang kami yang dahulu.

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
transliteration: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen

translations.en.sahih: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
translations.en.pickthall: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
translations.en.yusufali: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
translations.id.indonesian: la tidak lain hanyalah seorang laki-laki yang berpenyakit gila, maka tunggulah (sabarlah) terhadapnya sampai suatu waktu".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

translations.en.sahih: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
translations.en.yusufali: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berdoa: "Ya Tuhanku, tolonglah aku, karena mereka mendustakan aku".

arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
transliteration: Fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon

translations.en.sahih: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
translations.en.yusufali: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami wahyukan kepadanya: "Buatlah bahtera di bawah penilikan dan petunjuk Kami, maka apabila perintah Kami telah datang dan tanur telah memancarkan air, maka masukkanlah ke dalam bahtera itu sepasang dari tiap-tiap (jenis), dan (juga) keluargamu, kecuali orang yang telah lebih dahulu ditetapkan (akan ditimpa azab) di antara mereka. Dan janganlah kamu bicarakan dengan Aku tentang orang-orang yang zalim, karena sesungguhnya mereka itu akan ditenggelamkan.

arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen

translations.en.sahih: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
translations.en.pickthall: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
translations.en.yusufali: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila kamu dan orang-orang yang bersamamu telah berada di atas bahtera itu, maka ucapkanlah: "Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah menyelamatkan kami dari orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
transliteration: Wa qur Rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa Anta khairul munzileen

translations.en.sahih: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
translations.en.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
translations.en.yusufali: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berdoalah: Ya Tuhanku, tempatkanlah aku pada tempat yang diberkati, dan Engkau adalah sebaik-baik Yang memberi tempat".

arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya pada (kejadian) itu benar-benar terdapat beberapa tanda (kebesaran Allah), dan sesungguhnya Kami menimpakan azab (kepada kaum Nuh itu).

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
transliteration: Summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
translations.en.pickthall: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
translations.en.yusufali: Then We raised after them another generation.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian, Kami jadikan sesudah mereka umat yang lain.

arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
transliteration: Fa arsalnaa feehim Rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
translations.en.pickthall: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Kami utus kepada mereka, seorang rasul dari kalangan mereka sendiri (yang berkata): "Sembahlah Allah oleh kamu sekalian, sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan selain daripada-Nya. Maka mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa (kepada-Nya).

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
transliteration: Wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il Aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon

translations.en.sahih: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
translations.en.pickthall: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
translations.en.yusufali: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berkatalah pemuka-pemuka yang kafir di antara kaumnya dan yang mendustakan akan menemui hari akhirat (kelak) dan yang telah Kami mewahkan mereka dalam kehidupan di dunia: "(Orang) ini tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kamu, dia makan dari apa yang kamu makan, dan meminum dari apa yang kamu minum.

arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon

translations.en.sahih: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
translations.en.pickthall: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
translations.en.yusufali: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya jika kamu sekalian mentaati manusia yang seperti kamu, niscaya bila demikian, kamu benar-benar (menjadi) orang-orang yang merugi.

arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
transliteration: A-Ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon

translations.en.sahih: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
translations.en.pickthall: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
translations.en.yusufali: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah ia menjanjikan kepada kamu sekalian, bahwa bila kamu telah mati dan telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, kamu sesungguhnya akan dikeluarkan (dari kuburmu)?

arabic: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon

translations.en.sahih: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
translations.en.pickthall: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
translations.en.yusufali: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
translations.id.indonesian: jauh, jauh sekali (dari kebenaran) apa yang diancamkan kepada kamu itu,

arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
transliteration: In hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen

translations.en.sahih: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
translations.en.pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
translations.en.yusufali: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
translations.id.indonesian: kehidupan itu tidak lain hanyalah kehidupan kita di dunia ini, kita mati dan kita hidup dan sekali-kali tidak akan dibangkitkan lagi,

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
transliteration: In huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen

translations.en.sahih: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
translations.en.pickthall: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
translations.en.yusufali: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ia tidak lain hanyalah seorang yang mengada-adakan kebohongan terhadap Allah, dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan beriman kepadanya".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
transliteration: Qaala Rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
translations.en.yusufali: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
translations.id.indonesian: Rasul itu berdoa: "Ya Tuhanku, tolonglah aku karena mereka mendustakanku".

arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
translations.en.pickthall: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
translations.en.yusufali: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Dalam sedikit waktu lagi pasti mereka akan menjadi orang-orang yang menyesal".

arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
translations.en.pickthall: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
translations.en.yusufali: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dimusnahkanlah mereka oleh suara yang mengguntur dengan hak dan Kami jadikan mereka (sebagai) sampah banjir maka kebinasaanlah bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
transliteration: Summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen

translations.en.sahih: Then We produced after them other generations.
translations.en.pickthall: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
translations.en.yusufali: Then We raised after them other generations.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami ciptakan sesudah mereka umat-umat yang lain.

arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
transliteration: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

translations.en.sahih: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
translations.en.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
translations.en.yusufali: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak (dapat) sesuatu umatpun mendahului ajalnya, dan tidak (dapat pula) mereka terlambat (dari ajalnya itu).

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Summa arsalnaa Rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar Rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
translations.en.yusufali: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami utus (kepada umat-umat itu) rasul-rasul Kami berturut-turut. Tiap-tiap seorang rasul datang kepada umatnya, umat itu mendustakannya, maka Kami perikutkan sebagian mereka dengan sebagian yang lain. Dan Kami jadikan mereka buah tutur (manusia), maka kebinasaanlah bagi orang-orang yang tidak beriman.

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Summa arsalnaa Moosaa wa akhaahu Haaroona bi Aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
translations.en.pickthall: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
translations.en.yusufali: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami utus Musa dan saudaranya Harun dengan membawa tanda-tanda (Kebesaran) Kami, dan bukti yang nyata,

arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
transliteration: Ilaa Fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem

translations.en.sahih: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
translations.en.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
translations.en.yusufali: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
translations.id.indonesian: kepada Fir'aun dan pembesar-pembesar kaumnya, maka mereka ini takbur dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang sombong.

arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
transliteration: Faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
translations.en.pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Apakah (patut) kita percaya kepada dua orang manusia seperti kita (juga), padahal kaum mereka (Bani Israil) adalah orang-orang yang menghambakan diri kepada kita?"

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
transliteration: Fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen

translations.en.sahih: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
translations.en.pickthall: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
translations.en.yusufali: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka (tetaplah) mereka mendustakan keduanya, sebab itu mereka adalah termasuk orang-orang yang dibinasakan.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
translations.en.yusufali: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan Al Kitab (Taurat) kepada Musa, agar mereka (Bani Israil) mendapat petunjuk.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
transliteration: Wa ja'alnab na Maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een

translations.en.sahih: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
translations.en.pickthall: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
translations.en.yusufali: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah Kami jadikan (Isa) putera Maryam beserta ibunya suatu bukti yang nyata bagi (kekuasaan Kami), dan Kami melindungi mereka di suatu tanah tinggi yang datar yang banyak terdapat padang-padang rumput dan sumber-sumber air bersih yang mengalir.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Yaaa aiyuhar Rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'Aleem

translations.en.sahih: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
translations.en.pickthall: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
translations.en.yusufali: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
translations.id.indonesian: Hai rasul-rasul, makanlah dari makanan yang baik-baik, dan kerjakanlah amal yang saleh. Sesungguhnya Aku Maha Mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan.

arabic: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
transliteration: Wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa Ana Rabbukum fattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya (agama tauhid) ini, adalah agama kamu semua, agama yang satu, dan Aku adalah Tuhanmu, maka bertakwalah kepada-Ku.

arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
transliteration: Fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon

translations.en.sahih: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
translations.en.pickthall: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
translations.en.yusufali: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian mereka (pengikut-pengikut rasul itu) menjadikan agama mereka terpecah belah menjadi beberapa pecahan. Tiap-tiap golongan merasa bangga dengan apa yang ada pada sisi mereka (masing-masing).

arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
transliteration: Fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen

translations.en.sahih: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
translations.en.pickthall: So leave them in their error till a time.
translations.en.yusufali: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka biarkanlah mereka dalam kesesatannya sampai suatu waktu.

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
transliteration: A-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen

translations.en.sahih: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
translations.en.pickthall: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
translations.en.yusufali: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka mengira bahwa harta dan anak-anak yang Kami berikan kepada mereka itu (berarti bahwa),

arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
transliteration: Nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon

translations.en.sahih: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
translations.en.pickthall: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
translations.en.yusufali: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami bersegera memberikan kebaikan-kebaikan kepada mereka? Tidak, sebenarnya mereka tidak sadar.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
transliteration: Innal lazeena hum min khashyati Rabbihim mushfiqoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berhati-hati karena takut akan (azab) Tuhan mereka,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum bi Aayaati Rabbihim yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
translations.en.pickthall: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
translations.en.yusufali: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang beriman dengan ayat-ayat Tuhan mereka,

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena hum bi Rabbihim laa yushrikoon

translations.en.sahih: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
translations.en.pickthall: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
translations.en.yusufali: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang tidak mempersekutukan dengan Tuhan mereka (sesuatu apapun),

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
transliteration: Wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa Rabbihim raaji'oon

translations.en.sahih: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
translations.en.pickthall: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
translations.en.yusufali: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang memberikan apa yang telah mereka berikan, dengan hati yang takut, (karena mereka tahu bahwa) sesungguhnya mereka akan kembali kepada Tuhan mereka,

arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
transliteration: Ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon

translations.en.sahih: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
translations.en.pickthall: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
translations.en.yusufali: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka itu bersegera untuk mendapat kebaikan-kebaikan, dan merekalah orang-orang yang segera memperolehnya.

arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon

translations.en.sahih: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
translations.en.pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
translations.en.yusufali: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami tiada membebani seseorang melainkan menurut kesanggupannya, dan pada sisi Kami ada suatu kitab yang membicarakan kebenaran, dan mereka tidak dianiaya.

arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
transliteration: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon

translations.en.sahih: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
translations.en.yusufali: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi hati orang-orang kafir itu dalam kesesatan dari (memahami kenyataan) ini, dan mereka banyak mengerjakan perbuatan-perbuatan (buruk) selain daripada itu, mereka tetap mengerjakannya.

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
transliteration: Hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon

translations.en.sahih: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
translations.en.pickthall: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
translations.en.yusufali: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila Kami timpakan azab, kepada orang-orang yang hidup mewah di antara mereka, dengan serta merta mereka memekik minta tolong.

arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
transliteration: Laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon

translations.en.sahih: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
translations.en.pickthall: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
translations.en.yusufali: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
translations.id.indonesian: Janganlah kamu memekik minta tolong pada hari ini. Sesungguhnya kamu tiada akan mendapat pertolongan dari Kami.

arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
transliteration: Qad kaanat Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon

translations.en.sahih: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
translations.en.pickthall: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
translations.en.yusufali: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ayat-ayat-Ku (Al Quran) selalu dibacakan kepada kamu sekalian, maka kamu selalu berpaling ke belakang,

arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
transliteration: Mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon

translations.en.sahih: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
translations.en.pickthall: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
translations.en.yusufali: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
translations.id.indonesian: dengan menyombongkan diri terhadap Al Quran itu dan mengucapkan perkataan-perkataan keji terhadapnya di waktu kamu bercakap-cakap di malam hari.

arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
translations.en.pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan perkataan (Kami), atau apakah telah datang kepada mereka apa yang tidak pernah datang kepada nenek moyang mereka dahulu?

arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
transliteration: Am lam ya'rifoo Rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon

translations.en.sahih: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
translations.en.pickthall: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka tidak mengenal rasul mereka, karena itu mereka memungkirinya?

arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
translations.en.pickthall: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
translations.id.indonesian: Atau (apakah patut) mereka berkata: "Padanya (Muhammad) ada penyakit gila". Sebenarnya dia telah membawa kebenaran kepada mereka, dan kebanyakan mereka benci kepada kebenaran itu.

arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
transliteration: Wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon

translations.en.sahih: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
translations.en.pickthall: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
translations.en.yusufali: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
translations.id.indonesian: Andaikata kebenaran itu menuruti hawa nafsu mereka, pasti binasalah langit dan bumi ini, dan semua yang ada di dalamnya. Sebenarnya Kami telah mendatangkan kepada mereka kebanggaan (Al Quran) mereka tetapi mereka berpaling dari kebanggaan itu.

arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
transliteration: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju Rabbika khairunw wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen

translations.en.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
translations.en.pickthall: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
translations.en.yusufali: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
translations.id.indonesian: Atau kamu meminta upah kepada mereka?", maka upah dari Tuhanmu adalah lebih baik, dan Dia adalah Pemberi rezeki Yang Paling Baik.

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
transliteration: Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
translations.en.yusufali: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar menyeru mereka kepada jalan yang lurus.

arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
transliteration: Wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon

translations.en.sahih: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang tidak beriman kepada negeri akhirat benar-benar menyimpang dari jalan (yang lurus).

arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
transliteration: Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

translations.en.sahih: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
translations.en.pickthall: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
translations.en.yusufali: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
translations.id.indonesian: Andaikata mereka Kami belas kasihani, dan Kami lenyapkan kemudharatan yang mereka alami, benar-benar mereka akan terus menerus terombang-ambing dalam keterlaluan mereka.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
transliteration: Wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li Rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon

translations.en.sahih: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
translations.en.pickthall: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
translations.en.yusufali: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah pernah menimpakan azab kepada mereka, maka mereka tidak tunduk kepada Tuhan mereka, dan (juga) tidak memohon (kepada-Nya) dengan merendahkan diri.

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon

translations.en.sahih: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
translations.en.pickthall: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
translations.en.yusufali: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
translations.id.indonesian: Hingga apabila Kami bukakan untuk mereka suatu pintu tempat azab yang amat sangat (di waktu itulah) tiba-tiba mereka menjadi putus asa.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
translations.en.pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dialah yang telah menciptakan bagi kamu sekalian, pendengaran, penglihatan dan hati. Amat sedikitlah kamu bersyukur.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
translations.en.pickthall: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
translations.en.yusufali: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dialah yang menciptakan serta mengembang biakkan kamu di bumi ini dan kepada-Nya-lah kamu akan dihimpunkan.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
transliteration: Wa Huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
translations.en.pickthall: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Dialah yang menghidupkan dan mematikan, dan Dialah yang (mengatur) pertukaran malam dan siang. Maka apakah kamu tidak memahaminya?

arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
transliteration: Bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon

translations.en.sahih: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
translations.en.yusufali: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya mereka mengucapkan perkataan yang serupa dengan perkataan yang diucapkan oleh orang-orang dahulu kala.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
transliteration: Qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon

translations.en.sahih: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
translations.en.pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
translations.en.yusufali: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Apakah betul, apabila kami telah mati dan kami telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kami benar-benar akan dibangkitkan?

arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
translations.en.pickthall: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kami dan bapak-bapak kami telah diberi ancaman (dengan) ini dahulu, ini tidak lain hanyalah dongengan orang-orang dahulu kala!".

arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
translations.en.pickthall: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Kepunyaan siapakah bumi ini, dan semua yang ada padanya, jika kamu mengetahui?"

arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
translations.en.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
translations.en.yusufali: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "Maka apakah kamu tidak ingat?"

arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Qul mar Rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa Rabbul 'Arshil 'Azeem

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
translations.en.pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Siapakah Yang Empunya langit yang tujuh dan Yang Empunya 'Arsy yang besar?"

arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
transliteration: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
translations.en.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
translations.en.yusufali: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "Maka apakah kamu tidak bertakwa?"

arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa Huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
translations.en.pickthall: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Siapakah yang di tangan-Nya berada kekuasaan atas segala sesuatu sedang Dia melindungi, tetapi tidak ada yang dapat dilindungi dari (azab)-Nya, jika kamu mengetahui?"

arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
transliteration: Sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
translations.en.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
translations.en.yusufali: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "(Kalau demikian), maka dari jalan manakah kamu ditipu?"

arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
transliteration: Bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon

translations.en.sahih: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
translations.en.yusufali: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya Kami telah membawa kebenaran kepada mereka, dan sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar orang-orang yang berdusta.

arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; Subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

translations.en.sahih: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
translations.en.pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
translations.en.yusufali: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
translations.id.indonesian: Allah sekali-kali tidak mempunyai anak, dan sekali-kali tidak ada tuhan (yang lain) beserta-Nya, kalau ada tuhan beserta-Nya, masing-masing tuhan itu akan membawa makhluk yang diciptakannya, dan sebagian dari tuhan-tuhan itu akan mengalahkan sebagian yang lain. Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka sifatkan itu,

arabic: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: 'Aalimil Ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

translations.en.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
translations.en.pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
translations.en.yusufali: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
translations.id.indonesian: Yang mengetahui semua yang ghaib dan semua yang nampak, maka Maha Tinggilah Dia dari apa yang mereka persekutukan.

arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
transliteration: Qur Rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
translations.en.pickthall: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
translations.en.yusufali: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku, jika Engkau sungguh-sungguh hendak memperlihatkan kepadaku azab yang diancamkan kepada mereka,

arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
translations.en.pickthall: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
translations.en.yusufali: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
translations.id.indonesian: ya Tuhanku, maka janganlah Engkau jadikan aku berada di antara orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
translations.en.yusufali: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar kuasa untuk memperlihatkan kepadamu apa yang Kami ancamkan kepada mereka.

arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
transliteration: Idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon

translations.en.sahih: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
translations.en.pickthall: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
translations.en.yusufali: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
translations.id.indonesian: Tolaklah perbuatan buruk mereka dengan yang lebih baik. Kami lebih mengetahui apa yang mereka sifatkan.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
transliteration: Wa qur Rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish Shayaateen

translations.en.sahih: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
translations.en.pickthall: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
translations.en.yusufali: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku aku berlindung kepada Engkau dari bisikan-bisikan syaitan.

arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
transliteration: Wa a'oozu bika Rabbi ai-yahduroon

translations.en.sahih: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
translations.en.pickthall: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
translations.en.yusufali: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku berlindung (pula) kepada Engkau ya Tuhanku, dari kedatangan mereka kepadaku".

arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
transliteration: Hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala Rabbir ji'oon

translations.en.sahih: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
translations.en.pickthall: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
translations.en.yusufali: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
translations.id.indonesian: (Demikianlah keadaan orang-orang kafir itu), hingga apabila datang kematian kepada seseorang dari mereka, dia berkata: "Ya Tuhanku kembalikanlah aku (ke dunia),

arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
transliteration: La'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
translations.en.pickthall: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
translations.en.yusufali: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
translations.id.indonesian: agar aku berbuat amal yang saleh terhadap yang telah aku tinggalkan. Sekali-kali tidak. Sesungguhnya itu adalah perkataan yang diucapkannya saja. Dan di hadapan mereka ada dinding sampal hari mereka dibangkitkan.

arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
transliteration: Fa izaa nufikha fis Soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon

translations.en.sahih: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
translations.en.pickthall: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
translations.en.yusufali: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila sangkakala ditiup maka tidaklah ada lagi pertalian nasab di antara mereka pada hari itu, dan tidak ada pula mereka saling bertanya.

arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
transliteration: Faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

translations.en.sahih: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
translations.en.pickthall: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
translations.en.yusufali: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa yang berat timbangan (kebaikan)nya, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang dapat keberuntungan.

arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
transliteration: Wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee Jahannnama khaalidoon

translations.en.sahih: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
translations.en.pickthall: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
translations.en.yusufali: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa yang ringan timbangannya, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang merugikan dirinya sendiri, mereka kekal di dalam neraka Jahannam.

arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
transliteration: Talfahu wujoohahumun Naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood

translations.en.sahih: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
translations.en.pickthall: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
translations.en.yusufali: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
translations.id.indonesian: Muka mereka dibakar api neraka, dan mereka di dalam neraka itu dalam keadaan cacat.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Alam takun Aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon

translations.en.sahih: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
translations.en.pickthall: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
translations.en.yusufali: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah ayat-ayat-Ku telah dibacakan kepadamu sekalian, tetapi kamu selalu mendustakannya?

arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
translations.en.pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami, kami telah dikuasai oleh kejahatan kami, dan adalah kami orang-orang yang sesat.

arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
transliteration: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon

translations.en.sahih: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ya Tuhan kami, keluarkanlah kami daripadanya (dan kembalikanlah kami ke dunia), maka jika kami kembali (juga kepada kekafiran), sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zalim".

arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
transliteration: Qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
translations.en.yusufali: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Tinggallah dengan hina di dalamnya, dan janganlah kamu berbicara dengan Aku.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona Rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khairur raahimeen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
translations.en.yusufali: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya, ada segolongan dari hamba-hamba-Ku berdoa (di dunia): "Ya Tuhan kami, kami telah beriman, maka ampunilah kami dan berilah kami rahmat dan Engkau adalah Pemberi rahmat Yang Paling Baik.

arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
transliteration: Fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon

translations.en.sahih: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
translations.en.pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
translations.en.yusufali: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu kamu menjadikan mereka buah ejekan, sehingga (kesibukan) kamu mengejek mereka, menjadikan kamu lupa mengingat Aku, dan adalah kamu selalu mentertawakan mereka,

arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
transliteration: Inee jazaituhumul Yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
translations.en.yusufali: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Aku memberi balasan kepada mereka di hari ini, karena kesabaran mereka; sesungguhnya mereka itulah orang-orang yang menang".

arabic: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
transliteration: Qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
translations.en.pickthall: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
translations.en.yusufali: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
translations.id.indonesian: Allah bertanya: "Berapa tahunkah lamanya kamu tinggal di bumi?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
