translations.en.pickthall: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka menjawab: "Kami tinggal (di bumi) sehari atau setengah hari, maka tanyakanlah kepada orang-orang yang menghitung".

arabic: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
translations.en.pickthall: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
translations.en.yusufali: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
translations.id.indonesian: Allah berfirman: "Kamu tidak tinggal (di bumi) melainkan sebentar saja, kalau kamu sesungguhnya mengetahui"

arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
transliteration: Afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon

translations.en.sahih: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
translations.en.pickthall: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?
translations.en.yusufali: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu mengira, bahwa sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan kamu secara main-main (saja), dan bahwa kamu tidak akan dikembalikan kepada Kami?

arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Kareem

translations.en.sahih: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
translations.en.pickthall: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Maha Tinggi Allah, Raja Yang Sebenarnya; tidak ada Tuhan selain Dia, Tuhan (Yang mempunyai) 'Arsy yang mulia.

arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
transliteration: Wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda Rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon

translations.en.sahih: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
translations.en.pickthall: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
translations.en.yusufali: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa menyembah tuhan yang lain di samping Allah, padahal tidak ada suatu dalilpun baginya tentang itu, maka sesungguhnya perhitungannya di sisi Tuhannya. Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang kafir itu tiada beruntung.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
transliteration: Wa qur Rabbigh fir warham wa Anta khairur raahimeen

translations.en.sahih: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
translations.en.pickthall: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
translations.en.yusufali: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku berilah ampun dan berilah rahmat, dan Engkau adalah Pemberi rahmat Yang Paling baik".
